pages.title: Vanadium Bed
pages.text: Vanadium pentoxide on a silica support, in rings. At four hundred degrees it hands oxygen to sulfur dioxide and takes it back from the air, over and over.
Made in $(item)Catalyst Formulator$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Contact Process.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Vanadium Flow Battery.
